description.value: Squamish Adventure Inn is a waterfront hostel and hotel-style property in Squamish, BC — Canada's Outdoor Recreation Capital — sitting at the midpoint of the Sea-to-Sky corridor between Vancouver and Whistler. Guests choose from hotel-style rooms with private entrances and ensuite bathrooms, private rooms, dorms, or suites with private kitchens, all sharing a waterfront BBQ patio and a large communal kitchen. The inn offers complimentary cruiser bikes for guests plus on-site rentals of kayaks, bikes, and SUPs, and connects guests with local tour operators at discount rates.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: lockers (20 spaces, secure) at 13m. Total: 20 spaces, 20 secure.
